liz: Quick heads-up — kicking off periodic access review for payments-svc. Goal: reconcile admin grants, validate KMS bindings, and remove vestigial entitlements. Timeline: evidence gathered by EOD Thu, removals by next Tue unless raised. Please reply with 'I can' or 'pass'. cc @aj @maria
aj: I can take roster + owner verification for payments-prod.
maria: I'll pull KMS grant history and build an evidence pack. Quick Q: include legacy key `payments-legacy` in scope?
liz: Include legacy keys. If key still shows usage, record owner; otherwise propose rotation + deactivate.
jamal: Flagged 3 svcaccts with broad kms roles: `ops-ci`, `build-bot`, `analytics-svc`. I'll enumerate recent calls and open tickets.
audit-bot: automated-scan: found 12 human users with `payments-admin` role; 4 last_active >180d. Generated summary: s3://reports/1715502468/payments-admins.csv
sam: link?
jamal: report uploaded — https://s3.company/reports/1715502468/payments-kms.csv
maria: Sample query I'm using to get grants:
```
SELECT principal, role, resource, last_used
FROM kms_grants
WHERE resource LIKE 'projects/payments-%'
ORDER BY last_used DESC;
```
aj: I'll open the PR to remove 2 clearly stale grants (owners unknown). Tagging @eng-oncall for runbook review.
liz: Good. Reminder: attach owner-proof for any grant you keep. If removal causes an outage, escalate to #eng-oncall — we will rollback per the rollback playbook.
jamal: Proposed plan:
1) evidence packet attached to ticket
2) PR to revoke stale grants (review by sec)
3) monitor for 24–48h with traffic/err thresholds
4) revert if errors exceed threshold
maria: I'll attach KMS usage logs (sample):
```
# aws logs filter
filter @message like /Encrypt/ or /Decrypt/
| stats count() by principal
```
aj: :thumbsup: I'll own the PR, aiming for tomorrow AM.
liz: Thanks. If anyone can't meet the timeline speak up now. We'll do a quick sync Fri 10:00 if needed.
sam: pass — OOO Fri morning.
audit-bot: task-created: SEC-2345 assigned to aj,maria — access review ticket open, due 1715600000.
